summary: Tested email delivery on payment verify via Emergent Resend + PDF hosting. All 9 pytest tests pass (regression + new email tests). Verify endpoint returns status='paid', download_url='/business-bookkeeping-system.pdf', email_sent=true when using delivered@resend.dev. Invalid signature returns 400 with no email sent and order marked 'signature_failed'. Hosted PDF served with application/pdf content-type (~104KB). Config self-check: EMAIL_FROM_NAME=Crevvo and EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY present in backend/.env; server.py send payload includes from_name=EMAIL_FROM_NAME. Frontend BuyModal renders 'PAY ₹290 SECURELY' on hero-cta-buy; source confirms DOWNLOAD_FILE='/business-bookkeeping-system.pdf' wired to data-testid='buy-download-button'. Did NOT complete a live payment.
critical_code_review_comments: send_delivery_email raises on non-2xx; verify_payment already wraps in try/except and logs, so email failures do not break paid confirmation - good.
Order doc email_sent flag only set on success; consider also tracking email_error/email_id for observability.
PRODUCT_PDF_URL is hard-coded to preview host in .env; when promoted to prod the value should switch to the prod domain so the emailed link isn't a preview URL.
seed_data_creation: Creates TEST orders in mongo.orders with emails delivered@resend.dev, bounced@resend.dev, buyer@shop.com
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests use live Razorpay keys - do NOT trigger real UI payment. HMAC signature is computed locally with RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET to hit /api/payments/verify. Use delivered@resend.dev as recipient to assert email_sent:true.
